subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Units 1–2 Review and Assessment: Short Test 1 and Unit 2 practice sheet
outcomes: Use test strategies: read the questions first and underline key words.
Review Unit 2 words: body parts and animal verbs.
Use must, might, can't and the first conditional correctly.

tf.s: Before listening, it helps to read the questions and look at the pictures.
tf.why: Yes, you know what to listen for.

tf.s: Whiskers are long hairs near a cat's nose.
tf.why: Yes, cats use whiskers to feel.

tf.s: Seals are good at diving because they have flippers.
tf.why: Yes, flippers help them swim and dive.

tf.s: A camel has a big hump on its back.
We use might when we are 100% sure.
tf.why: Might means we are not sure.

tf.s: Turtles and flamingos both lay eggs.
The correct sentence is: If you will touch the fish, it will swim away.
tf.why: Say: If you touch the fish, it will swim away.

tf.s: Underlining key words in a question can help you find the answer.
tf.why: Yes, key words show what to look for.

tf.s: Can't means we think something is possible.
tf.why: Can't means we are sure it is not possible.

boxes.q: I can't see the turtle. It ___ be under the water. (not sure)
boxes.why: Might shows we are not sure.

boxes.q: Complete: If a bee ___ you, it will hurt.
boxes.why: After if, use the present simple.

boxes.q: Which body parts help a fish swim?
boxes.why: Fish move their fins to swim.
Hedgehogs have spines on their back.

boxes.q: Which animal has a hard shell?
boxes.why: Turtles have a shell to stay safe.

boxes.q: It has no wings. It ___ be a bird.
boxes.why: Without wings, it is sure not to be a bird.

boxes.q: Which strategy helps in a test?
Which verb? A hedgehog makes itself into a ball.
boxes.why: Curl up = make a ball shape.

hunt.q: Long hairs near a cat's nose
Seals have these instead of feet
Sure it isn't: It ___ be a fish.
If you touch it, it ___ swim away.

mcq.q: What should you do before a listening task?
o: Read the questions and look at the pictures.
mcq.why: Knowing the questions helps you listen.

mcq.q: Which modal shows we are sure something is true?
Which of these is a body part?
Which list has only animals that lay eggs?
mcq.why: Birds, turtles and snakes lay eggs.

mcq.q: Choose: If you ___ (touch) the fish, it will swim away.
It's dark, but I hear a loud roar. It ___ be a lion!
Text: 'If you want a place to have fun with your children …' Which continuation fits?
o: We are open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
He will leave his job next week.
It has a big hump on its back.
mcq.why: A fun place tells you its opening times.

mcq.q: Seals have flippers. Why are they good at diving but not fast on land?
o: Flippers help in water but are not good for walking.
mcq.why: The same body part helps in water but not on land.

mcq.q: Which text continues with 'It also has a big hump on its back'?
o: an animal that lives in the desert and eats plants
a clown who is leaving his job
a place for families to have fun
mcq.why: A desert animal with a hump is a camel.

mcq.q: A student often spells body-part words wrong. What is the best plan?
o: I need to practise spelling body-part words.
I don't need to practise anything.
I will skip the spelling questions.
mcq.why: Good self-assessment names what to practise.
